text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Ben Ali held a meeting with visiting Saudi Prince Bandar bin Sultan bin Abdul-Aziz on bilateral relations.
-Transport Minister Sadok Rabeh said that Tunisia encourages foreign investors to invest in international road transportation.
-Tunisia aims at reinforcing bilateral cooperation with Development Islamic Bank (BID) in the private sector.
-Tunisia is drafting a law on international road transportation.
-Presidency Affairs Minister Mohamed Jegham chaired a ceremony for the distribution of new houses to poor families in the former shanty town of Douar Hicher near Tunis.
-The International Mediterranean Association of tomatoes (AMITOM) holds its annual meeting on Friday 20 in Tunis. Tunisia production in tomatoes was 750,000 tonnes in 1996.
